$comment: Generated by `doctor-toolkit types-gen` from data/gf2/ (enums.toml, engine_messages.txt); do not edit.

building_type.description: Building types. Source: values of attribute 1 of the Building objects; the names of the types are not known (data).
building_type.title: Building types

city.description: Cities. Source: attribute 0 of the City objects; Building 3 and other attributes hold sdbm(lower(name)) (data).
city.title: Cities

crew_rank.description: Ranks of made men. Source: rank a place of the family tree of the player asks for (0x0090B0A0); AddPlayerFamilyMember 2 (the reader 0x0090A1D0 keeps 3..5), Sentient 1 of a character template (exe).
crew_rank.title: Ranks of made men

crew_specialty.description: Crew specialties. Source: bits of the crew slot field +0x10 tested by 0x009630E0 of godfather2.exe, which returns the text key $crew_specialty_<name> (exe).
crew_specialty.title: Crew specialties

emotion.description: Emotions. Source: records of the pad resource (set `pedestrian`, gf2/globals_global); each record holds sdbm(lower(name)) (data).
emotion.title: Emotions

engine_message.description: Source: data/gf2/engine_messages.txt (exe). Letter case does not matter: the game hashes the lower-case name.
enum: Sent to a sentient to stop them from burning
Sent to an entity to clear falling flag
Sent to an entity to commence falling
Sent to an entity when paired animation change required
engine_message.title: Messages named by godfather2.exe

family.description: Families. Source: attribute 1 of the Family objects of gf2/globals_global; the engine keeps sdbm(lower(name)) at Family+0x54 (lookup 0x008C74D0) (data).
family.title: Families

data.description: The data word; "unknown" unless read in the code.

owner.description: The mod of a custom message.

message_name.description: A message of the bus: an engine message, a message of the game files (data/gf2/game_messages.tsv) or a new one. On the bus it is sdbm(lower(name)).
message_name.title: Message name

mod_messages.description: `messages` of mod.json: names the SimGroups of the mod send or hear and the game does not have. A name must not be a game message and its hash must not be the hash of one (`mods build` and `validate` check).
mod_messages.title: Messages a mod adds

semantic_type.description: Source: data/gf2/attr_types.toml and the pins of data/gf2/logic_schema.toml.
semantic_type.title: Meaning of a SimGroup attribute

sound_category.description: Sound categories. Source: records of the auc resource (gf2/globals_global, gf2/frontend): name[64], parent group[36] (data).
sound_category.title: Sound categories

venue.description: Venues (buildings). Source: attribute 0 of the Building objects (the id CMD_SetVenueID attributes repeat); note: city (Building 3), owner family in the data (Building 4), type (Building 1), stream, more_objects (other Building objects with the same id) (data).
venue.title: Venues (buildings)

weapon.description: Weapons and items. Source: attribute 0 of the Item packet of Gun, ThrowableItem and Item objects; value: Item 3 (item type number) (data).
weapon.title: Weapons and items

weapon_licence.description: Weapon licences. Source: level of a made man in the record of his honours (0x008BCF90, byte +0x28): it starts from the flags of his SimNpc (0x00790150: bit 3 gives 2, bit 4 gives 3) and rises with honours (0x008BCE30: 10, 25, 70) (exe).
weapon_licence.title: Weapon licences
